name: Shock Grid
source: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World
description: A tight grid of ionized particles crisscrosses the door into the computer center, hissing audibly and glowing bright blue.
disable: DC 19 Computers or Physical Science Lore|dc:19 to disable the shock grid through the keypad, or DC 21 Crafting or DC 21 Thievery to short-circuit the wires along the grid's perimeter
reset: The trap resets automatically until disabled or until it can no longer detect any living creatures within 10 feet of the door outside in area E2.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shocking!
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature fails their check to disable the shock grid or walks through the shock grid

Effect The triggering creature takes (4d8+10) Electricity Damage damage with a Basic DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw save.
